facts.text: The university charges zero tuition or fees for course instruction and books, requiring undergraduate students to pay only a $60 application fee and a $180 assessment fee per course.

sources.title: UoPeople Fees | Low Cost, High Quality | University of the People
sources.quote: At UoPeople there is no cost for instruction, books, or traditional campus costs. Our mission is to make higher education affordable and accessible.

sources.title: UoPeople Fees | Low Cost, High Quality | University of the People
sources.quote: For each undergraduate course, there is an assessment fee of $180.
